name: anofox-forecast-eda
description: Exploratory data analysis, data quality, and statistical diagnostics for the anofox_forecast DuckDB extension — 36 per-series statistics, data-quality scoring, quality-report summaries, 117 tsfresh-inspired feature extraction, and 7 diagnostic functions covering stationarity (ADF, KPSS, combined verdict) and residual adequacy (Ljung-Box, Durbin-Watson, Jarque-Bera, combined report). Use before forecasting to understand series characteristics (length, gaps, trend, seasonality strength, intermittency) or to validate model residuals after fitting.
